title: Uniform Equality Pair Tester
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number, and consider Boolean strings of length $2n$. Define a tester that samples an index uniformly from $ in n$ and, at its two transcript positions, queries the addresses obtained by applying the equality-pair address map to that index and to $0$ and $1$, respectively. It accepts exactly when both answers are present and equal.
caveat: The equality-pair address map is used in the formal statement but is not defined in the supplied snippet, so its precise address construction cannot be stated.
